title: AI-assisted document drafting chat (ANDS dossier builder)
walkthrough:
You are inside a dossier's module workspace: a section tree on the left, the working panel in the middle, and a right-hand rail showing module progress ("3/8 required sections complete" style), plus readiness flags "Documents", "Fee", and "Valid eCTD". In the tree, each section shows a status glyph, its eCTD number, a "req" or "opt" badge, and — on sections that support this flow — a small "✦AI" badge whose tooltip reads "This section supports interactive AI drafting — you review and approve before anything is saved".

Clicking such a section opens its panel: an eyebrow line ("Module 1 · Section …"), the section title, a guidance box headed "What Health Canada needs here" with a "Health Canada guidance ↗" link, and an action bar with tabs "⬆ Upload", "✦ Author in-app", and sometimes "⊘ Mark N/A". Choosing "✦ Author in-app" reveals a second toggle: "💬 Draft with AI" versus "✦ Sample & edit".

On "💬 Draft with AI" you get a chat panel. Intro text explains: "Chat with an AI assistant to draft this document — it will ask for any details it needs instead of leaving blanks. Nothing is saved until you click Use this draft." The empty thread prompts: "Tell it about the submission to get started — it knows what [section title] needs." You type into a textarea (placeholder: "e.g. Sponsor is Acme Pharma Inc., contact regulatory@acme.example") and press Enter or "Send"; while the reply streams in, the button reads "Thinking…". If the AI backend is not configured, a red notice says "AI drafting isn't set up yet (no GROQ_API_KEY). Use the standard "Author" button below instead, or ask an admin to configure it." — you cannot fix this yourself.

Once an assistant reply exists, a "Use this draft →" button appears ("Saving…" while it works). Accepting saves the document; a screen-reader live-region announcement (not a visible message) states the section was "saved as an AI-assisted draft — provenance is recorded in the audit trail", directing you to "Review vs Health Canada" under "✦ Sample & edit" to check required elements before filing — the content review is not run automatically for AI drafts. The attached document then appears in the panel with filename, size, checksum, a "Download" link, and a warning-styled provenance chip reading "AI-assisted — review before filing"; its tooltip states it was "Drafted interactively with the AI assistant under your direction" and recorded in the audit trail.
